<script>
(function () {
  var PERIOD = 1500;
  var K = [0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400, 1500];
  // [leftEyeCx, leftEyeCy, leftEyeSpacing, rightEyeCx, rightEyeCy, rightEyeSpacing, handDx, handDy, pencilRot]
  var V = [
    [69,   89, 34, 135.5, 69, 27,  0,  0,   0],
    [65,   87, 31, 131,   69, 28, -5,  0,  -2],
    [62,   85, 30, 126,   68, 30, -9, -2,  -5],
    [59,   76, 27, 126.5, 66, 29, -6, -2,  -8],
    [61.5, 74, 27, 127,   69, 28, -4, -3, -10],
    [59,   71, 26, 126,   70, 28, -4, -3, -10],
    [64,   69, 28, 124,   72, 27, -4, -3, -10],
    [65,   69, 26, 125.5, 72, 27, -4, -3, -10],
    [69,   89, 34, 135.5, 69, 27,  0,  0,   0]
  ];

  var LB = "M18,208 C4,182 3,135 20,102 C33,72 48,55 70,55 C96,55 113,72 119,98 C126,128 126,172 116,208 Z";
  var LA = "M14,140 C6,165 9,192 22,205 C32,213 46,205 42,192 C36,176 31,160 30,142 Z";
  var RB = "M106,92 C101,62 116,42 140,42 C166,42 186,56 196,76 C216,96 236,130 239,170 C241,196 231,216 202,219 L142,216 C128,202 122,172 126,142 C116,128 109,110 106,92 Z";
  var RA = "M124,106 C110,124 99,150 97,170 C95,186 110,194 118,184 C124,166 136,142 148,124 Z";

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  var el = {
    lBody: $("left-body-shape"), lBelly: $("left-belly"), lHead: $("left-head"),
    lEyeL: $("left-eye-l"), lEyeR: $("left-eye-r"), lArm: $("left-arm-shape"),
    lHandPencil: $("left-hand-pencil"),
    rBody: $("right-body-shape"), rHead: $("right-head"),
    rEyeL: $("right-eye-l"), rEyeR: $("right-eye-r"), rArm: $("right-arm-shape"),
    rHand: $("right-hand-reaching")
  };

  function ss(e0, e1, x) {
    var t = (x - e0) / (e1 - e0);
    t = t < 0 ? 0 : (t > 1 ? 1 : t);
    return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
  }
  function weight(x, y, cx, cy, r0, r1) {
    return 1 - ss(r0, r1, Math.sqrt((x - cx) * (x - cx) + (y - cy) * (y - cy)));
  }
  function deform(path, fn) {
    return path.replace(/(-?\d*\.?\d+),(-?\d*\.?\d+)/g, function (m, a, b) {
      var p = fn(+a, +b);
      return p[0].toFixed(2) + "," + p[1].toFixed(2);
    });
  }
  function sample(t) {
    t = ((t % PERIOD) + PERIOD) % PERIOD;
    var i = 0;
    while (i < K.length - 2 && t >= K[i + 1]) i++;
    var u = (t - K[i]) / (K[i + 1] - K[i]);
    var a = V[i], b = V[i + 1], out = [];
    for (var j = 0; j < a.length; j++) out.push(a[j] + (b[j] - a[j]) * u);
    return out;
  }
  function f(n) { return n.toFixed(2); }

  function render(t) {
    var p = sample(+t || 0);
    var lcx = p[0], lcy = p[1], lsp = p[2];
    var rcx = p[3], rcy = p[4], rsp = p[5];
    var hdx = p[6], hdy = p[7], prot = p[8];

    // ---- Left character ----
    var lhx = lcx - 69, lhy = lcy - 89;
    var lbx = lhx * 0.5, lby = lhy * 0.7;
    var lFn = function (x, y) {
      var w = weight(x, y, 66, 80, 25, 115);
      return [x + lbx * w, y + lby * w];
    };
    el.lBody.setAttribute("d", deform(LB, lFn));
    el.lArm.setAttribute("d", deform(LA, lFn));
    var bp = lFn(73, 172);
    el.lBelly.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + f(bp[0] - 73) + "," + f(bp[1] - 172) + ")");
    el.lHead.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + f(lhx) + "," + f(lhy) + ")");
    var leo = lsp / 2 - 17;
    el.lEyeL.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + f(-leo) + ",0)");
    el.lEyeR.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + f(leo) + ",0)");
    el.lHandPencil.setAttribute("transform", "rotate(" + f(prot) + " 32 206)");

    // ---- Right character ----
    var rhx = rcx - 135.5, rhy = rcy - 69;
    var rbx = rhx * 0.9, rby = rhy * 0.9;
    var rFn = function (x, y) {
      var w = weight(x, y, 135, 65, 30, 105);
      return [x + rbx * w, y + rby * w];
    };
    el.rBody.setAttribute("d", deform(RB, rFn));
    el.rArm.setAttribute("d", deform(RA, function (x, y) {
      var q = rFn(x, y);
      var wh = weight(x, y, 104, 185, 12, 55);
      return [q[0] + hdx * wh, q[1] + hdy * wh];
    }));
    el.rHand.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + f(hdx) + "," + f(hdy) + ")");
    el.rHead.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + f(rhx) + "," + f(rhy) + ")");
    var reo = rsp / 2 - 13.5;
    el.rEyeL.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + f(-reo) + ",0)");
    el.rEyeR.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + f(reo) + ",0)");
  }

  window.nwb = { render: render };
  render(0);
})();
</script>
